description:
A compliance officer has received opt-out requests from 10 consumers who must be added to the company's internal Do Not Call (DNC) list. The phone numbers are stored in the file ~/Documents/VicidialData/dnc_optout_requests.txt (one 10-digit US phone number per line).

Your task:
1. Log into the Vicidial admin interface at http://localhost/vicidial/admin.php (credentials: user 6666, password andromeda).
2. Navigate to the Internal DNC list management section.
3. Add all 10 phone numbers from ~/Documents/VicidialData/dnc_optout_requests.txt into the Internal DNC list. You should use the bulk add/upload feature to ensure efficiency.
4. Confirm the numbers have been added successfully.

All 10 numbers must appear in the system-wide Internal DNC list so that no campaign in the dialer can call these numbers.
